code: set.seed(42) n <- 156 spend <- pmax(0, rnorm(n, 500, 250)) truth <- 0.7 kpi <- 200 + 0.5 * adstock_geometric(spend, decay = truth) + rnorm(n, sd = 5)  no_kpi_objective <- function(x, max_lag, decay) {   z <- adstock_geometric(x, decay, max_lag = max_lag)   errs <- vapply(78:(n - 1), function(e) {     m <- lm(z[1:e] ~ seq_len(e))     (x[e + 1] - (coef(m)[1] + coef(m)[2] * (e + 1)))^2   }, numeric(1))   sqrt(mean(errs)) }  g <- expand.grid(max_lag = c(2, 5, 10, 20), decay = c(0.1, 0.5, 0.9)) g$error <- mapply(function(l, d) no_kpi_objective(spend, l, d),                   g$max_lag, g$decay) g[order(g$error), ] #>    max_lag decay error #> 1        2   0.1 232.6 #> 2        5   0.1 232.6 #> 3       10   0.1 232.6 #> 4       20   0.1 232.6 #> 5        2   0.5 232.7 #> 9        2   0.9 232.8 #> 6        5   0.5 233.1 #> 7       10   0.5 233.2 #> 8       20   0.5 233.2 #> 10       5   0.9 234.1 #> 11      10   0.9 236.7 #> 12      20   0.9 241.7 spread <- c(spread_across_whole_grid = max(g$error) / min(g$error) - 1,             spread_across_best_four = sort(g$error)[4] / min(g$error) - 1) spread #> spread_across_whole_grid  spread_across_best_four  #>                3.944e-02                5.913e-05

code: library(mediamix) data(mm_weekly) north <- mm_weekly[mm_weekly$geo == "north", ] north <- north[order(north$date), ] window <- which(north$date >= as.Date("2023-07-03"))  robyn_hyp <- list(tv_thetas = 0.6, tv_alphas = 2.2, tv_gammas = 0.5,                   search_thetas = 0.1, search_alphas = 1.1,                   search_gammas = 0.4) channels <- c(tv = "tv", search = "search") args <- lapply(channels, function(ch) {   from_robyn(north[[ch]],              theta = robyn_hyp[[paste0(ch, "_thetas")]],              alpha = robyn_hyp[[paste0(ch, "_alphas")]],              gamma = robyn_hyp[[paste0(ch, "_gammas")]],              window = window) }) str(args$tv) #> List of 2 #>  $ adstock   :List of 3 #>   ..$ kernel   : chr "geometric" #>   ..$ decay    : num 0.6 #>   ..$ normalise: logi FALSE #>  $ saturation:List of 3 #>   ..$ type    : chr "hill" #>   ..$ half_max: num 3213 #>   ..$ shape   : num 2.2 half_life(c(tv = 0.6, search = 0.1)) #>     tv search  #>  1.357  0.301 # Robyn's adstock_geometric(): the unnormalised recursion, from a_1 = x_1. robyn_geometric <- function(x, theta) {   x_decayed <- c(x[1], rep(0, length(x) - 1))   for (xi in 2:length(x_decayed)) {     x_decayed[xi] <- x[xi] + theta * x_decayed[xi - 1]   }   x_decayed }  # Robyn's saturation_hill() from 3.12.0: the inflexion point is gamma times # the largest adstocked value in the window. robyn_hill <- function(x, alpha, gamma) {   inflexion <- max(x) * gamma   x**alpha / (x**alpha + inflexion**alpha) } difference <- vapply(channels, function(ch) {   adstocked <- robyn_geometric(north[[ch]], robyn_hyp[[paste0(ch, "_thetas")]])   robyn <- robyn_hill(adstocked[window],                       alpha = robyn_hyp[[paste0(ch, "_alphas")]],                       gamma = robyn_hyp[[paste0(ch, "_gammas")]])   ours <- media_transform(north[[ch]], adstock = args[[ch]]$adstock,                           saturation = args[[ch]]$saturation)[window]   max(abs(ours - robyn)) }, numeric(1)) difference #>        tv    search  #> 2.220e-16 1.665e-16

code: w156 <- from_robyn(north$tv, adstock = "weibull_cdf", shape = 1.2,                    scale = 0.04) w104 <- from_robyn(north$tv[1:104], adstock = "weibull_cdf", shape = 1.2,                    scale = 0.04) c(periods_from_156_rows = w156$adstock$scale,   periods_from_104_rows = w104$adstock$scale) #> periods_from_156_rows periods_from_104_rows  #>                     7                     5 robyn_weibull_cdf <- function(x, shape, scale) {   windlen <- length(x)   x_bin <- 1:windlen   scale_trans <- round(quantile(1:windlen, scale), 0)   theta_vec <- c(1, 1 - pweibull(head(x_bin, -1), shape = shape,                                  scale = scale_trans))   theta_vec_cum <- cumprod(theta_vec)   x_decayed <- mapply(function(x_val, x_pos) {     x_vec <- c(rep(0, x_pos - 1), rep(x_val, windlen - x_pos + 1))     lagged <- c(rep(0, x_pos - 1), theta_vec_cum)[seq_len(windlen)]     x_vec * lagged   }, x_val = x, x_pos = seq_along(x))   rowSums(x_decayed) }  ours <- media_transform(north$tv, adstock = w156$adstock, saturation = NULL) max(abs(ours - robyn_weibull_cdf(north$tv, shape = 1.2, scale = 0.04))) #> [1] 5.457e-12 n <- nrow(north) d <- dweibull(1:n, shape = 2.5, scale = round(quantile(1:n, 0.1))) robyn_pdf_kernel <- (d - min(d)) / (max(d) - min(d)) tv_pdf <- adstock_filter(north$tv, weights = robyn_pdf_kernel)

code: library(mediamix) data(mm_weekly) truth <- attr(mm_weekly, "truth")  north <- mm_weekly[mm_weekly$geo == "north", ] channels <- c("tv", "video", "search", "social", "display") controls <- data.frame(week = seq_len(nrow(north)), price = north$price,                        seasonality = north$seasonality,                        holiday = north$holiday) joint <- tune_carryover_joint(north[channels], north$revenue,                               controls = controls) rbind(estimate = joint$best$decay, truth = truth$decay[channels]) #>            tv video search social display #> estimate 0.80   0.5   0.65   0.55    0.60 #> truth    0.85   0.7   0.15   0.45    0.55 spec <- lapply(stats::setNames(channels, channels), function(ch) list(   adstock = list(decay = truth$decay[[ch]]),   saturation = list(half_max = truth$half_max[[ch]],                     shape = truth$shape[[ch]]) )) media <- transform_plan(north, spec)[channels] fit <- lm(north$revenue ~ ., data = cbind(media, controls)) contrib <- contributions(media, fit, index = north$date) roi(contrib, north[channels]) #>   channel contribution  spend   roi #> 1  social       132709  36716 3.614 #> 2  search       208307  74560 2.794 #> 3   video       102461  53248 1.924 #> 4 display        40853  26937 1.517 #> 5      tv       349629 266978 1.310 plot(contrib) tv <- marginal_roi(north$tv, coefficient = coef(fit)[["tv"]],                    adstock = list(decay = truth$decay[["tv"]]),                    saturation = list(half_max = truth$half_max[["tv"]],                                      shape = truth$shape[["tv"]])) tv #>    spend contribution  roi  mroi #> 1 266978       349629 1.31 1.253

code: data(mm_weekly) north <- mm_weekly[mm_weekly$geo == "north", ] channels <- c("tv", "video", "search", "social", "display") truth <- attr(mm_weekly, "truth")  # Transform once, on the full series, then bootstrap the model on top. spec <- lapply(stats::setNames(channels, channels), function(ch) list(   adstock = list(decay = truth$decay[[ch]]),   saturation = list(half_max = truth$half_max[[ch]],                     shape = truth$shape[[ch]]))) media <- transform_plan(north[channels], spec) names(media) <- paste0(channels, "_t") d <- cbind(north, media, week = seq_len(nrow(north)))  average_roi <- function(d) {   fit <- lm(revenue ~ tv_t + video_t + search_t + social_t + display_t +               week + price + seasonality + holiday, data = d)   contrib <- colSums(sweep(as.matrix(d[paste0(channels, "_t")]), 2,                            coef(fit)[paste0(channels, "_t")], `*`))   stats::setNames(contrib / colSums(d[channels]), channels) }  boot <- block_bootstrap(d, average_roi, times = 50, block_length = 13,                         seed = 1) boot #>  #> ── Block bootstrap  #> 50 replicates, blocks of 13 rows, 90% percentile intervals #>     term estimate    lower upper std_error #>       tv    1.310  1.10874 1.882    0.2579 #>    video    1.924  0.01862 3.495    1.1227 #>   search    2.794  1.58295 4.258    0.8991 #>   social    3.614  0.51808 5.213    1.4353 #>  display    1.517 -0.03334 5.217    1.6852  # A panel: every geography takes the same blocks of weeks. pooled_mean <- function(d) c(revenue = mean(d$revenue)) block_bootstrap(mm_weekly, pooled_mean, times = 50, block_length = 13,                 by = "geo", index = "date", seed = 1) #>  #> ── Block bootstrap  #> 50 replicates, blocks of 13 periods shared across groups, 90% percentile #> intervals #>     term estimate lower upper std_error #>  revenue    26271 25485 26682     370.5

code: # Recover a known decay from data simulated with it set.seed(42) n <- 120 spend <- pmax(0, rnorm(n, 500, 250)) truth <- 0.7 kpi <- 200 + 0.5 * adstock_geometric(spend, decay = truth) + rnorm(n, sd = 8)  tuned <- tune_carryover(   spend, kpi,   max_lags = Inf,   decays = seq(0.1, 0.9, by = 0.1) ) tuned #>  #> ── Carryover tuning  #> rolling_origin resampling, 60 splits, 9 grid points #> Best: decay = 0.7 (half-life 1.94 periods), max_lag = infinite #> rmse (pooled) = 7.3134, std. error 0.659 tuned$best$decay #> [1] 0.7  # The shortest carryover the data cannot distinguish from the best tuned$best_1se$decay #> [1] 0.7  # Keep the out-of-sample forecasts, for example to look at the best one kept <- tune_carryover(spend, kpi, max_lags = Inf,                        decays = seq(0.1, 0.9, by = 0.1), save_pred = TRUE) best <- kept$predictions[kept$predictions$decay == kept$best$decay, ] head(best) #>   split row max_lag decay observed predicted #> 1     1  61     Inf   0.7 422.5377  419.9361 #> 2     2  62     Inf   0.7 432.2015  435.7249 #> 3     3  63     Inf   0.7 465.5809  461.7442 #> 4     4  64     Inf   0.7 513.6887  511.1374 #> 5     5  65     Inf   0.7 463.4245  464.9368 #> 6     6  66     Inf   0.7 499.1164  509.6529 c(rmse(best$observed, best$predicted), kept$best$metric) #> [1] 7.313401 7.313401  # Tune against a model with controls rather than the bare default. Passed # as `controls`, the trend and seasonality are fitted inside every training # window, so no split learns from KPI values that come after it. season <- sin(2 * pi * seq_len(n) / 52) trend <- seq_len(n) kpi2 <- kpi + 40 * trend + 300 * season  bare <- suppressWarnings(tune_carryover(   spend, kpi2, max_lags = Inf, decays = seq(0.1, 0.9, by = 0.1) )) with_controls <- tune_carryover(   spend, kpi2, max_lags = Inf, decays = seq(0.1, 0.9, by = 0.1),   controls = data.frame(trend, season) )  # The truth is 0.7. Ignoring the trend and seasonality moves the answer. c(truth = 0.7, bare = bare$best$decay, controls = with_controls$best$decay) #>    truth     bare controls  #>      0.7      0.9      0.7
